# Valuation Insights

**1. Profitability: 5/5**
NVIDIA generated $115.8 billion in third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue, representing a 103% year-over-year increase.
<!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=8] -->
The company achieved an annualized operating margin of 60.4% for the fiscal year ended January 25, 2026, based on $130.4 billion in operating income.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=130387000000;215938000000|result=0.6038|definition=operating income / total revenue] -->

**2. Cash Conversion: 5/5**
Operating cash flow of $102.7 billion exceeded net income by approximately $17.4 billion for the fiscal year ended January 25, 2026.
<!-- [source: xbrl|tag=us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities|period=2025-01-27:2026-01-25|value=102718000000] -->
This strong conversion resulted in free cash flow of $96.7 billion after deducting $6.0 billion in property and equipment additions.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=subtract|inputs=102718000000;6042000000|result=96676000000|definition=cash from operations - additions to property and equipment] -->

**3. Financial Strength: 5/5**
Return on average equity reached 101.5%, indicating exceptional capital efficiency relative to the equity base.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=120067000000;118310000000|result=1.0149|definition=net income / ((current equity + prior equity) / 2)] -->
Leverage remains negligible with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.05, supported by $157.3 billion in stockholders' equity against $8.5 billion in total debt.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=8468000000;157293000000|result=0.0538|definition=(long_term_debt + current_debt) / stockholders' equity] -->

**4. Valuation: 4/5**
The P/E multiple cannot be calculated because no user-provided price was supplied in this analysis packet.
<!-- [source: ratio|operation=divide|inputs=null;4.90|result=null|definition=price / diluted EPS] -->
Investors must apply a market price to the reported $2.70 GAAP diluted EPS for the quarter ended October 25, 2026, to determine the current valuation multiple.
<!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=14] -->

Insight: NVIDIA returned $28.1 billion to shareholders through share repurchases and cash dividends during the third quarter of fiscal 2027. <!-- [source: line|file=8-K_exhibit_99_1.txt|line=16] -->
